title: 第7章 任家怪事妖气起第8章 瞬秒功德到手
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
“这……”
九叔眉头微皱，暗暗思索起来。
任发也只好不言语，等着九叔发话。
任婷婷忽然起身，低声道：“爸爸，你们聊正事，我先去买胭脂去了。”
“去吧。”任发也拦着，摆摆手后，旋即冲九叔苦闷道，“九叔啊，你说这是不是有问题？”
九叔微微颔首，认真道：“若任老爷有忧虑，待我选好迁葬之地，今晚我师徒三人，前往任府做一场法事如何？”
“求之不得，求之不得。”
任发闻言，顿时大喜过望，连声感谢。
九叔开口叫到：“林凡，你也动身吧，去通知下你两个师弟。晚些到任府集合。”
“是，师父。”
林凡随即便起身往义庄方向走去。
……
入夜，任府。
文才与秋生将作法道具，整齐的摆放在法台之上。
随后站于法台两边，扭头面向点点头示意九叔可以开始。
左手持香脚将香头朝下点燃。
随后左右摆动将明火熄灭，立于坛中。
九叔开坛作法林凡在旁辅佐。
剑指竖起，由下往上没过桃木剑。
随之一并竖起。

“天地自然，晃朗太元，八方威神，使我符命。普告九天，洞罡太玄，斩妖缚邪度人万千！急急如律令！”
九叔熟练的念着【净天地神咒】。
随后师徒四人，给任府周遭贴上符咒。
此间任府上下，乃至大门都被符咒沾满。
让府内众人格外安心。
九叔开口道：“任老爷，你们不用太过担心。”
随着夜空越发的深暗。
夜色在深沉与静谧相互交织，如同湖面般平静，丝毫没有一丝波动。
深深的夜色里，没有嘈杂的声音，只有宁静的气息。
让人感到深深的平静与满足。
随着漫长的等待任府上下仿佛都快似要进入梦乡一般。
伴随而来的就是困意。
“师父，我看这妖怪多半是被你吓跑了。”
秋生漫不经心的打着哈欠说道。
content_en:
"This..."
Uncle Jiu frowned slightly and began to think secretly.
Ren Fa had no choice but to remain silent and wait for Uncle Jiu to speak.
Ren Tingting suddenly stood up and whispered: "Dad, you guys talk about business, I'm going to buy rouge first."
"Go." Ren Fa also stopped him. After waving his hand, he immediately said to Uncle Jiu in anguish, "Uncle Jiu, do you think there is something wrong with this?"
Uncle Jiu nodded slightly and said seriously: "If Mr. Ren is worried, after I choose the burial place, how about my master and disciple go to the Ren Mansion to perform a ritual ceremony tonight?"
“You can’t get what you ask for, and you can’t get what you ask for.”
When Ren Fa heard this, he was immediately overjoyed and thanked him repeatedly.
Uncle Jiu called out: "Lin Fan, you should leave too and inform your two junior brothers. Meet at Ren Mansion later."
"Yes, Master."
Lin Fan immediately stood up and walked towards Yizhuang.
…
At night, Renfu.
Wen Cai and Qiu Sheng neatly placed the ritual props on the altar.
Then he stood on both sides of the altar, turned his head and nodded to indicate to Uncle Jiu that he could start.
Hold the incense foot in your left hand and light the incense head downward.
Then he swayed left and right to extinguish the open fire and stood in the altar.
Lin Fan assisted Uncle Jiu in opening the altar.
The sword finger was raised, covering the mahogany sword from bottom to top.
Then put it up together.
"The nature of heaven and earth, the shining light of Taiyuan, the mighty gods from all directions, make me fulfill my destiny. I will tell the nine heavens, the cave is Taixuan, kill the demons, bind the evil, and save thousands of people! Be as urgent as the law and order!"
Uncle Jiu recited the [Godly Mantra for Purifying Heaven and Earth] skillfully.
Then the four masters and apprentices put talismans around Ren's house.
Here, the whole house and even the door are covered with spells.
It makes everyone in the house feel at ease.
Uncle Jiu said, "Master Ren, you don't have to worry too much."
As the night sky becomes darker and darker.
The night was deep and quiet, as calm as the surface of a lake, without any fluctuations.
In the deep night, there is no noisy sound, only the breath of tranquility.
It makes people feel deeply peaceful and content.
With the long wait, everyone in the Ren family seemed to be about to fall asleep.
What follows is sleepiness.
"Master, I think this monster was probably scared away by you."
Qiu Sheng yawned casually and said.
